name: Choukou Sentai Justice Blade Zero ~Daishuryou no Teki wa Daishuryou~
original_name: 超光戦隊ジャスティスブレイドZERO ～大首領の敵は大首領～
source:
After the shocking twist at the end of Justice Blade 3, the Great Leader, Dark Jade, lost his mask and memories.
Now, in an alternate version of Japan where Dark Jade continues to scheme in the shadows, a new threat looms.
Who is the True Great Leader, the mastermind behind Dark Jade’s reign?

To counter their menace, advanced technology from another world is being analyzed to develop the ultimate weapon: the Hyperlight Squadron Justice Blade, a team of warriors designed to annihilate Dark Jade.
However, their power relies on the Blade Suit, which can only be worn by those with a special trait called the JB Factor.
Meanwhile, the protagonist—stripped of his mask and parts of his memory—is unexpectedly recruited as a support member of the Justice Blade team.
Will he regain his lost power and memories?
The great leader's new battle begins...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006692.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
在《超光战队正义之刃3》结尾的惊人反转之后，大首领黑玉失去了面具与记忆。
如今，在这个黑玉继续于暗中策划阴谋的平行日本，新的威胁正在逼近。
真正的大首领究竟是谁？又是谁在幕后操纵着黑玉的统治？

为了对抗他们，人们开始分析来自异世界的先进科技，研发终极武器“超光战队正义之刃”——一支专为歼灭黑玉而设计的战士队伍。
然而，这支队伍的力量依赖“刀刃战衣”，只有拥有特殊特质“JB因子”的人才能穿着。
与此同时，失去面具和部分记忆的主人公意外被招募为正义之刃队伍的支援成员。
他能否找回失去的力量与记忆？
大首领的新战斗，就此开始……
